message:
Swift/Hummingbird: favorite in one lookup-and-toggle round trip

POST and DELETE /api/articles/:slug/favorite do the slug lookup and the
insert/delete in one statement (CTE), then read the article: two round
trips instead of three. A missing slug still returns 404.

Phases 4-5 scope: writeList was already concurrent (earlier commit).
Follow and comment delete are already two round trips, so unchanged.
Bcrypt stays on the concurrent GCD queue: GCD caps its width near the
core count, so an extra bound would add little. jsonEscape and
rfc3339ms were already hand-written; unchanged.

Conformance 197/197. Local 1000-user run on the full seed: 0% errors,
p95 4.2 ms.
